event: In a review of Anthropic’s August 2026 risk report, METR agreed that catastrophic misalignment risk for covered models was low, but said risks of broad or targeted interference with safety-relevant research and the apparent weakness of Anthropic’s monitoring were greater than public evidence had suggested. METR also discussed the disclosed cybersecurity-evaluation incidents as more severe than earlier observed cases. (Anthropic, 2026-10-20.)
